author: blu
body: Proves the first slice of wiring the layer system into the live engine: layer-4 type-changing. Kormus Bell ("all Swamps are 1/1 creatures") carries a StaticAbility AnimateType Black 1 1. The characteristic reads now derive from the battlefield: a Swamp is a creature (effective-is-creature), a 1/1 (effective- power/toughness), and mortal -- one point of damage feeds the state-based-action sweep, which now consults effective-is-creature and destroys it. Without the Bell the same Swamp is not a creature and survives the damage. No per-permanent state, no card is drafted yet -- this is the characteristic + SBA foundation.
